Founded in New Zealand 12 years ago, we’re working with some of the best and largest retailers in the world across the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and the UK. Auror is connecting people and intelligence to reduce crime. We’re using technology for good.
  
  
Our mission is clear: reduce violent retail crime by 50% in 5 years. It's an ambitious goal - and one we believe is achievable. In partnership with our leading retail partners, we need people with the passion, determination, and innovation required to overcome one of the world's largest problems. Since our founding in 2016, we have proudly served clients across more than 172 countries, helping them grow in the world of trading. In 2025, we were honoured with 17 global industry awards. With this recognition, we look forward to even greater achievements as we continue to innovate and deliver outstanding services.  
  
As the first CFD broker to support the UN Global Compact (UNGC), we’re committed to making a positive impact in our diverse communities. A significant milestone in our journey has been the establishment of the UM Foundation, which supports the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), driving positive change across the globe. Ultima Markets UK Limited is a company registered in England and Wales, company registration number 06249714.  
  
Position Summary  
The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing regional marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, qualified lead generation, and client acquisition for our UK-regulated entity, strictly within FCA regulatory frameworks and financial promotion guidelines.  
  
The role demands a deep understanding of complex financial instruments (CFDs, FX, and multi-asset trading), digital acquisition channels, and rigorous compliance standards. The Marketing Manager will collaborate closely with Sales, Business Development, Compliance, and Senior Management to translate commercial targets into impactful, compliant marketing campaigns.  
  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategy, Planning & Campaign Management  

* Develop and execute annual and quarterly regional marketing plans, campaigns, and localized budgets aligned with UK business growth objectives and revenue targets.
* Plan and manage multi-channel lead-generation campaigns (digital, social, email, search, webinars) optimized to drive account applications and funded trading accounts.
* Report to internal stakeholders on digital channel (SEO/PPC/social/Email) performances against set KPIs while making insight led recommendations
* Oversee conversion funnel optimization across digital touchpoints to lower Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) and maximize Marketing ROI.

  
FCA Compliance & Financial Promotions  

* Ensure all marketing collateral, website copy, landing pages, social media posts, and educational materials strictly comply with FCA financial promotion rules (COBS) and relevant regulatory mandates.
* Coordinate seamlessly with the Compliance and Legal teams to establish a robust sign-off workflow for all public-facing campaigns, ensuring mandatory risk warnings (e.g., CFD loss percentages) are prominently displayed.
* Monitor regulatory updates from the FCA regarding the trading restrictions, inducements, and marketing conduct, adapting strategies proactively.

  
Market & Competitor Analysis  

* Conduct periodic competitor research to analyse competitor strategies, strengths, weaknesses, campaigns, and market positioning.
* Monitor industry trends, customer behaviour, and market developments.
* Provide actionable recommendations to enhance market competitiveness and product positioning.

  
Branding & Communications  

* Oversee the execution of branding initiatives to strengthen brand awareness and market presence.
* Ensure consistency of messaging, visual identity, and customer experience across all marketing channels.
* Support public relations, sponsorships, partnerships, and corporate communication initiatives where required.

  
Performance & Analytics  

* Track, analyse, and report campaign performance against established KPIs and business objectives.
* Use data, customer insights, A/B testing, and analytics to continuously optimise marketing performance and return on investment.
* Prepare regular marketing performance reports and recommendations for management.

Stakeholder Management  

* Collaborate with internal teams including Business Development, Compliance, Operations, and Senior Management.
* Manage relationships with external agencies, vendors, media partners, and content providers.
* Support regional teams with marketing materials, campaigns, and local market initiatives.

  
Qualifications & Experience  
Essential  

* Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Finance, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Product Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
* Experience within Financial Services, CFDs, Forex, Trading, Fintech, Brokerage, or Investment-related industries.
* Strong understanding of financial markets, trading products, and client acquisition strategies.
* Experience managing integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
* Strong content creation, copywriting, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in digital marketing platforms, CRM systems, and analytics tools.

  
Preferred

* Experience working with affiliate, partnership, and introducing broker programmes.
* Experience managing agencies and regional marketing projects.

Crucially, those listens are monetized wherever they happen - across any podcast app or listening platform.

**About the role**  
Acast is looking for an Internal Communications Manager to cover a period of maternity leave within our Comms & Brand team. You'll be the day-to-day owner of internal communications across the business - keeping our global team informed, connected and engaged at a time of fast growth and change.

Sitting within Comms & Brand and reporting to the Chief Communications & Brand Officer, you'll run the rhythm of internal comms: our all-company moments, leadership communications, and the culture programmes that make Acast a brilliant place to work. You'll also partner closely with our People team on key initiatives such as our performance and reward and recognition programmes.

This is a delivery-focused role for someone who's a confident, hands-on internal communicator and thrives on keeping lots of moving parts running smoothly. There'll be a full handover with our current Internal Communications Director.

Please note this is a fixed term contract of approximately 10 months.

**What you'll do**

*All-Company Communications*

* Own the planning, production and delivery of our global All-Hands - preparing talking points, slides, exec sections and presenter guides, managing content, and running the sessions live.
* Write and deliver clear, engaging company-wide communications across our channels (primarily Slack and email).
* Support internal communications around earnings, acquisitions and other key business moments, working closely with the CCBO and leadership.

*Culture & Engagement*

* Lead the delivery of comms around our culture programmes - including values, recognition, wellbeing and seasonal moments - bringing them to life for a global team.
* Champion an open, inclusive and caring culture through everything we communicate internally.

*People Partnership*

* Partner with the People team on the communications around key employee programmes.
* Help managers and leaders communicate well - providing guidance, templates and editorial support so they can land their own messages with confidence.

*Keeping the Engine Running*

* Manage the day-to-day drumbeat of internal comms, prioritising across competing requests and deadlines.
* Maintain and improve our internal channels, keeping information clear, findable and well-organised.

**Who you are**

* A Confident Internal Communicator: You have a proven track record in internal or employee communications, ideally in a fast-moving, global or remote-first business.
* A Brilliant Writer: You can turn complex or sensitive information into clear, warm, on-brand communication - and help others do the same.
* Highly Organized: You're comfortable juggling multiple programmes, tight timelines and competing priorities, and you keep everything moving without dropping a ball.
* Calm Under Pressure: You handle high-stakes, exec-facing moments - like All-Hands or earnings - with a steady hand and great judgement.
* A Natural Collaborator: You build strong relationships quickly and work easily across People, leadership and the wider business.
* Culture-First: You care about how people experience their work, and you bring energy and empathy to everything you communicate.

**Location and Hybrid Work**

This role is based out of our East London office (Bevenden Street), so you will need to live within a reasonable commuting distance. Because this is a global role, we offer a flexible hybrid setup: we encourage you to come in at least Wednesdays to connect with the local team, while the rest of the week is up to you, aside from occasional all-hands meetings, earnings call or key collaborative sessions.

**Culture**

Acast is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin or any of the other wonderful characteristics that make us different.

Culture is our number one priority as a business. We believe people come first, and we work every day to enable autonomy, continuous improvement and bring out the best in people. We’re global and have remote teams, so it’s even more important that we strive for an open, inclusive and caring environment where everyone feels visible and welcome.

We consider ourselves a modern organization driven by strong values to create the best, most fulfilling and nurturing culture.

We very much look forward to finding the next great person to join our cause!

**About Flock**
---------------

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

**About the role**
------------------

Flock is on a hypergrowth trajectory, coming off a record-breaking Q3 and on track for Q4, and we're looking for someone to take the reins of marketing and drive the next stage of that growth. You'll do it at the frontier of AI in fleet insurance, in a heavily AI-powered business where AI is driving impact in every team.

You'll own Flock's marketing strategy, brand and budget, reporting to our co-founder and Chief Commercial Officer. We've dramatically increased the marketing budget because we're planning to go big, and you'll have a Marketing Manager reporting to you who owns events and content delivery. You'll set the direction, but this is still a hands-on role for someone who gets things done, with a run-until-tackled mindset and the drive to show how far a small, AI-native team can go.

**Brand and launches.** Flock has been through its acquisition by Admiral, and the Flock and Admiral Business propositions will become increasingly connected from here. You'll be central to taking that joined-up offer to market, owning how Flock by Admiral looks and sounds everywhere and leading every launch end to end. It's the best of both worlds, a fun, high-energy brand combined with the strongest name in UK insurance.

**Growth.** Every fleet we insure comes to us through an insurance broker, so brokers sit at the centre of how we grow. You'll build the campaigns, events strategy and broker programmes that grow both, alongside distribution, underwriting and product, and show what each pound returns.

**AI.** Our marketing is already heavily AI-powered, across design, web, email and video. You'll take it much further, building tools, agents and workflows so a team of two produces the output of ten, and you'll be the person Flock and Admiral turn to when they want to see what's possible next. Brokers and fleets still buy from people, so your craft and judgement stay at the centre of it.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* **Set the strategy.** Turn company OKRs into a marketing plan, own the budget and report the return in pipeline and broker growth.
* **Lead the team.** Manage and develop the Marketing Manager, and brief our agencies and suppliers.
* **Lead the brand.** Act as the owner and protector of the Flock brand on every single touchpoint.
* **Launch and grow.** Take products and propositions to market end to end, and run the broker campaigns, lifecycle emails and sales collateral that help our BDMs win business.
* **Shape the events strategy.** Choose events where Flock should have presence and come up with bold and creative ideas, with the Marketing Manager running delivery.
* **Build with AI.** Create tools and workflows, and share them so the whole business moves faster.

**What you’ll need**
--------------------

* 5+ years B2B marketing experience, including leading a function or major programme end to end, ideally in insurance, insurtech or fintech.
* Product launches and campaigns with commercial results you can point to.
* Strong brand instinct and craft, shown in your writing, your art direction and your eye for work that isn't good enough yet.
* Experience owning a budget and showing senior stakeholders what it returned.
* Experience managing people or agencies and raising the standard of their work.
* An AI-native way of working, with tools, workflows or campaigns you've built with AI to show for it.
* Ambition and ownership. You want to build something big, you move without waiting for a brief, and you can present to founders, Admiral leadership and a room of brokers with equal confidence.

Nice to have: insurance, fleet, telematics or broker distribution experience

**Benefits**
------------

* 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays)
* Share Incentive Plan
* Workplace Pension
* Private Medical Insurance (including Dental Optical & Mental Health support options)
* Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families
* Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay
* £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications
* £500 per annum towards learning and development
* 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.
